Baseline hosted API (public, pay-as-you-go) — US region (sample):

- Embeddings: $0.00040 / 1K tokens (or $X per 1K vectors depending on vector size in attachment).

EU hosting and data residency:
- There is a regional compute adder that applies when customer requests EU-only residency for request processing and logs: standard adder is +15% on compute token rates (applies to the per-token compute portion only).
- Storage/retention fees (audit logs, long-term traces) are billed separately as a monthly storage line item; residency does not change base storage rates unless you require locked-in HSM/KMS in-region (that adds a nominal monthly surcharge).
- Example: for 5M tokens / month with 70/30 US/EU split, the EU portion would use EU-hosted model endpoints and incur the +15% compute adder on those tokens. I included a worked example in the attached PDF.

Volume discounts / committed terms:
- PAYG: listed rates above.
- 3-month commit (non-binding): ~10% off compute for the committed tier.
- 12-month committed contract: up to 18% off compute depending on commit size and whether you accept cross-region routing fallback.
- We can also offer a one-time onboarding credit for pilots converting to committed annuals.

Hi Peter — looping in pricing/ops. A few concrete points and a worked example below.

1) EU adder scope: the +15% shown in the rate card applies to compute portion only (model inference CPU/GPU cycles). It is not applied to contracted storage or egress lines. If you require EU-only KMS/HSM we treat that as a separate managed key add-on (flat monthly).

2) Example calculation (PAYG):
- Total tokens: 5,000,000 / month
- Split: 70% US = 3,500,000 tokens; 30% EU = 1,500,000 tokens
- Baseline compute cost (illustrative): assume blended per-token compute $0.00060 (prompt+completion blended) -> 5,000,000 * $0.00060 = $3,000/month compute
- EU adder: 1,500,000 * $0.00060 * 0.15 = $135/month
- Estimated total compute (PAYG) = $3,135/month + storage/egress as applicable

3) 12-month committed option (example): commit to 6M tokens/month for 12 months -> applied 12% committed discount on compute after regional adder. Using the same blended numbers: compute pre-discount $3,000; EU adder $135; subtotal $3,135; post-discount (12%) = $2,757.60/month.

4) Onboarding credit & special pricing: for strategic fintech pilots we can propose a one-time onboarding credit of up to 10% and a locked EU adder at 12% for the first contract year (requires legal sign-off).
